content.label: Examiner note - alkanes substitute, they do not add
content.body: Methane + bromine needs ultraviolet light: a hydrogen is REPLACED by a bromine, making bromomethane + hydrogen bromide - a substitution. Because alkanes are saturated there is no double bond to add across; say 'substitution (in sunlight/UV)', never 'addition'. With bromine in excess the substitution can keep going, giving a mixture of CH3Br, CH2Br2 and beyond.
